items.title: India’s SEBI Weighs Exchange Platform for Pre-IPO Shares
items.author: Sidhartha Shukla
items.content: <article>India’s markets regulator is weighing a specialized trading platform as part of efforts to rein in the grey market for shares of companies headed for initial public offerings.</article>

items.title: Modi Nears Majority Needed to Increase India’s Parliament Seats
items.author: Atul Dev and Sudhi Ranjan Sen
items.content: <article>Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s government moved closer to clearing a contentious law to expand the size of India’s parliament after a regional opposition party declared support for the legislation.</article>

items.title: Norway’s Wealth Fund Again Votes No to Musk’s Tesla Pay Package
items.author: Heidi Taksdal Skjeseth
items.content: <article>Norway’s $2.2 trillion sovereign wealth fund said it is voting against Elon Musk’s 2025 pay package at Tesla Inc.’s annual meeting next week.</article>

items.title: Plunging Fuel Prices Bring Relief for Drivers and Central Banks
items.author: Alex Longley
items.content: <article>In a few short weeks, global fuel markets have lurched out of crisis, for now at least.</article>

items.title: Eisenkot Edging Closer to Leading Israel With Talks Progressing
items.author: Galit Altstein
items.content: <article>With just over a week to go, Gadi Eisenkot is within striking distance of a coalition breakthrough that could secure him a parliamentary majority and loosen Benjamin Netanyahu’s three-decade grip on Israeli politics.</article>

items.title: RBI Steps Up Gold Loan Scrutiny as Bullion Rout Signals Strain
items.author: Siddhi Nayak
items.content: <article>India’s banking regulator is stepping up scrutiny of the nation’s $247 billion gold-loan sector as a sharp drop in bullion prices erodes the collateral that lenders demand from borrowers, according to people familiar with the matter.</article>

items.title: Managing $300B for Ultra Wealthy Families: Masters in Business with Holly MacDonald
items.content: <article>Barry speaks with Holly MacDonald, CEO of Bessemer Trust. They discuss her time working in Brazil and how investing in emerging markets shapes her investment philosophy. They also discuss the enduring strength of the US dollar, and how Bessemer evolved from a single family office to a $300 billion enterprise. They also discuss how they navigate building generational wealth and moderating family conflicts.  (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: Trump’s AI Gambit Fuels Wild Thanksgiving Week on Wall Street
items.author: Emma Haidar
items.content: <article>The message from Washington this week was unmistakable: America must do whatever it takes to win the artificial-intelligence race with China, and the government is prepared to intervene to make it happen.</article>

items.title: Colombia Peso Stumbles as Mounting Risks Test Rally
items.author: Nicolle Yapur and Maria Elena Vizcaino
items.content: <article>The Colombian peso is headed for its worst month in more than four years as a toxic mix of trouble at home and abroad takes the shine off one of the year’s most resilient currencies.</article>

items.title: US Stocks Rebound as Traders Pile Into Battered Tech Shares
items.author: Jessica Menton
items.content: <article>US stocks rallied Friday, capping a week of whiplash as dip buyers scooped up some beaten down technology shares despite lingering worries about the sustainability of the artificial-intelligence boom.</article>

items.title: China Spurs Biggest Stock Gain Since 2024 on Rare Midday Vow
items.author: Bloomberg News
items.content: <article>Chinese authorities gave markets a boost with a rare midday statement pledging support, sending stocks to their best day in more than two years.</article>

items.title: Emerging-Market Stocks Snag Best Week Since June on Tech Rebound
items.author: Leda Alvim, Suvashree Ghosh and Mpho Hlakudi
items.content: <article>Emerging-market stocks posted their biggest weekly gain since June as investors piled back into technology shares following a recent selloff, capping a volatile week across global markets.</article>

items.title: Copper Surges Most in Seven Months as Risk Appetite Returns
items.author: Bloomberg News
items.content: <article>Copper climbed the most since April, extending its rebound from an 11-month low earlier this week, as risk appetite returned after a rout fueled by concerns over the artificial intelligence trade.</article>

items.title: Treasuries Drop as Stock Rise Saps Demand for Haven Bonds
items.author: Elizabeth Stanton and Liau Y-Sing
items.content: <article>US Treasuries fell as the market reopened after the Thanksgiving holiday, with gains in equities damping demand for haven assets.</article>

items.title: Brazil’s Real Caps Best Week Since 2020 as Trabuco Lifts Mood
items.author: Leda Alvim and Barbara Nascimento
items.content: <article>Brazilian markets rallied after President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva picked one of the nation’s most prominent bankers to be his finance minister, easing the worries about his economic policies that triggered a deep selloff after his surprise re-election last month.</article>

items.title: Gold Rises as Rebound in Tech Stocks Helps Revive Risk Appetite
items.author: Jack Ryan and Grace Asenov
items.content: <article>Gold rose as a rally in stocks helped the precious metal recover from a rout that sent bullion prices to a 15-month low.</article>

items.title: ‘Dollar Storm:’ Greenback on Track for Longest Winning Run Since 2024
items.author: Cole Lipsky, Melos Ambaye and Naomi Tajitsu
items.content: <article>The dollar climbed toward its longest monthly winning streak in two years as a rupture in the artificial intelligence trade and rising interest rates spur demand for safe-haven assets.</article>

items.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Nov. 27
items.author: Lorelei Smillie, Yurii Stasiuk and Charles Gorrivan
items.content: <article>Oil swung in thin trading as increasing attacks on energy infrastructure and tankers in the Middle East heightened supply fears.</article>

items.title: S&P 500 Has Best Week Since April 2025 on AI Rally: Markets Wrap
items.author: Rita Nazareth
items.content: <article>Wall Street wrapped up a chaotic week with stocks climbing as a rebound in the artificial-intelligence trade gathered pace, reducing demand for Treasuries and haven currencies.</article>

items.title: How Saks Is Reclaiming Luxury as Exemplar Luxury Group
items.content: <article>Bloomberg’s Romaine Bostick reports on how Exemplar Luxury Group, formerly known as Saks Global, is reinventing itself for a fresh start in luxury since emerging from bankruptcy earlier this year. Exemplar Luxury Group CEO Geoffroy van Raemdonck, FIT Associate Professor Shawn Grain Carter, Telsey Advisory Group CEO Dana Telsey, and Exemplary Luxury Group President and CCO Darcy Penick share their thoughts. (Source: Bloomberg)</article>
